club: Maples Tech Club (MTC) — Learn it. Build it. Ship it.

questions.question_text: Which shortcut quickly SAVES the document or drawing you are working on?
Which key moves your typing cursor to the NEXT LINE when writing a paragraph?
Which longest key on the bottom row of a keyboard adds a blank space between words?
Which shortcut selects EVERYTHING on the page or inside a folder at once?
Which shortcut CUTS (moves) selected text so you can paste it somewhere else?
While watching a video on YouTube or VLC, pressing the Spacebar usually does what?
Which shortcut opens the PRINT box to print a page or save it as a PDF?
In Word or Google Docs, what does pressing Ctrl + B do to selected text?
In a document editor, which shortcut makes selected text Italic (slanted)?
In a document editor, which shortcut UNDERLINES the selected words?
What is the difference between the Backspace key and the Delete key while typing?
questions.option_c: Backspace erases to the left of the cursor; Delete erases to the right of the cursor
questions.option_d: Both do the exact same thing

questions.question_text: If you want to quickly FIND a specific word on a long webpage or PDF, which shortcut do you press?
Which key at the top-left of the keyboard is commonly pressed to cancel a pop-up or exit full-screen video?
Which function key is the classic shortcut to REFRESH or reload a webpage in a browser?
If you pressed Ctrl + Z (Undo) by mistake and want your change back, which shortcut performs REDO?
Which keyboard shortcut lets you quickly switch between open apps/windows on Windows?
To type a single capital letter or the "@" symbol above the number 2 without turning on Caps Lock, which key do you hold?
Which shortcut opens a brand-new blank document or window in most apps?
What is the small wheel between the left and right buttons of a mouse used for?
questions.option_d: Scrolling up and down long pages

questions.question_text: Which machine puts your digital document or photo onto a real sheet of paper?
During an online video class, which hardware captures your live face so others can see you?
During a voice call or recording, which part captures your voice into the computer?
Which pocket-sized device plugs into a USB port to carry files between home and school?
On a laptop, what is the flat touch-sensitive rectangle below the keyboard that works like a mouse?
Pressing the RIGHT button on a computer mouse usually opens what?
questions.option_a: A small shortcut/context menu with helpful options

questions.question_text: Which classroom device shines your computer screen onto a large white wall or board so the whole class can watch?
On a smartphone or tablet, the screen both shows pictures AND senses your finger taps. What is it called?
What Does "Hardware" mean in simple everyday words?
questions.option_c: The physical parts of a computer that you can actually see and touch

questions.question_text: In Indian homes and school labs, a small box called a UPS is connected to desktop PCs. Why is it useful?
questions.option_a: It provides short battery backup during a power cut so you can save your work safely

questions.question_text: What is the opposite of a Printer — a device that turns a paper certificate or drawing into a digital image file on your PC?
Which single modern cable carries BOTH sharp high-definition video AND audio from a laptop to a TV or projector?
At a supermarket checkout or school library, which handheld device reads black-and-white striped labels instantly?
Why can a laptop keep running during a power cut even without an external UPS?
questions.option_b: Laptops have a built-in rechargeable battery inside

questions.question_text: What is the tiny removable storage card used inside many cameras and Android phones called?
What is the main job of the small spinning fan inside a laptop or desktop cabinet?
questions.option_c: To blow dust onto the screen
questions.option_d: To keep the processor and internal parts cool so the computer does not overheat

questions.question_text: In everyday phones and computers, what is the simple difference between RAM and Storage (SSD/ROM)?
questions.option_b: Both are names for the screen
questions.option_c: RAM stores photos forever; Storage deletes everything on restart
questions.option_d: RAM holds active apps temporarily while working; Storage keeps your photos and files saved even when powered off

questions.question_text: Which application is best for making visual slideshows to present a project in front of your class?
What do we call the main welcome screen with icons and wallpaper that appears after logging in to a PC?
Which popular free media player with an orange traffic-cone icon plays almost any video or audio file?
On an Android smartphone, which official app store is used to safely install apps?
Look at the file name "annual_day_photo.jpg". What kind of file is it?
Look at the file name "school_anthem.mp3". What kind of file is it?
Look at the file name "science_fair_demo.mp4". What kind of file is it?
What are the three small buttons ( — , □ , ✕ ) at the top-right corner of almost every Windows app window for?
questions.option_c: Minimize, Maximize, and Close the window

questions.question_text: Which popular design app/website lets students easily create posters, certificates, and invitations using ready templates?
What does "Software" mean in simple everyday language?
questions.option_a: The apps, programs, and operating system that run inside a computer or phone
questions.option_c: The power socket on the wall
questions.option_d: Soft cloth used to clean a monitor

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an Operating System (the core system software that runs a PC or phone)?
Why do schools send circulars and admit cards as a ".pdf" file instead of an editable Word file?
questions.option_a: PDFs do not take even 1 byte of space
questions.option_c: PDFs keep the exact layout, fonts, and alignment looking identical on every phone and computer

questions.question_text: Which application is best suited for keeping an attendance list, marks table, or club budget with automatic totals?
What is the difference between "Copy & Paste" and "Cut & Paste" on a file?
questions.option_a: Copy leaves the original file in place and makes a duplicate; Cut moves the file to the new folder

questions.question_text: What is a ".zip" file commonly used for when sharing a project?
questions.option_b: Bundling many files/folders together into one smaller compressed file for easy sending

questions.question_text: In Word or Google Docs, what is the difference between "Save" and "Save As"?
questions.option_b: Both print the document on paper
questions.option_c: "Save" updates the current file; "Save As" lets you save a separate copy with a new name or location

questions.question_text: Which long bar at the bottom of a Windows screen shows the Start button, pinned apps, and clock?
Why do many students turn on "Dark Mode" in apps when reading or working in the evening?
questions.option_a: It makes Wi-Fi twice as fast
questions.option_c: It prints pages in black paper
questions.option_d: It uses a dark background that feels gentler on the eyes in low light

questions.question_text: If you find a super useful study website and want to save it inside your browser for one-click access tomorrow, you add a:
When your mouse pointer turns from an arrow into a little pointing HAND over colored/underlined text on a webpage, it means:
questions.option_b: It is a clickable link (hyperlink) to another page or file

questions.question_text: Where do files you download from Chrome or Edge normally get saved on your computer by default?
In an email app like Gmail, what does the small PAPERCLIP (📎) button let you do?
questions.option_a: Attach a file, photo, or PDF to send along with your email

questions.question_text: What is the website address typed at the top of a browser (like `https://mapleskhatauli.com`) commonly called?
What does the Left Arrow (←) "Back" button at the top-left of a browser do?
questions.option_b: Takes you back to the previous webpage you were just viewing

questions.question_text: Look at an email address: `student@mapleskhatauli.com`. Which symbol always separates the username from the domain name?
What is that square black-and-white patterned box on posters or ID cards that opens a link when scanned with a phone camera?
Which of these is ALSO a popular web browser besides Google Chrome?
questions.option_d: Mozilla Firefox / Microsoft Edge / Apple Safari

questions.question_text: If you visited a helpful website yesterday and forgot its name, which browser list helps you find it again?
What is the real difference between Google Chrome and Google Search?
questions.option_b: Chrome is a search website; Google is a laptop brand
questions.option_c: Chrome is the Browser app installed on your device; Google Search is a website used inside a browser to look up info

questions.question_text: When you see `https://` and a padlock icon in the browser address bar before logging in, what does the "s" in `https` mean?
questions.option_a: Secure — data between your browser and the website is encrypted so others on Wi-Fi cannot read your password

questions.question_text: What does opening an "Incognito" or "Private" browser window ACTUALLY do on a shared computer?
questions.option_a: It stops the browser from saving your browsing history, cookies, and login session on THAT computer after you close the window
questions.option_b: It makes you completely invisible to websites and your internet provider
questions.option_c: It gives free unlimited mobile data
questions.option_d: It blocks all computer viruses automatically

questions.question_text: If a webpage shows "404 — Page Not Found", what does that simply mean?
questions.option_b: The specific link or page was moved, deleted, or typed with a spelling mistake

questions.question_text: When writing a polite email to a teacher or competition organizer, why should you always fill in the "Subject" line?
questions.option_a: Subject is where you type your password
questions.option_c: So the receiver immediately knows what your email is about before even opening it
questions.option_d: Emails cannot be sent without 50 words in Subject

questions.question_text: If an expected registration confirmation email has not arrived in your Inbox, which email folder should you check next?
Why do websites sometimes ask you to tick "I am not a robot" or pick traffic lights (CAPTCHA)?
questions.option_a: To test your eyesight for driving
questions.option_d: To stop automated spam bots from creating fake accounts or flooding forms

questions.question_text: In Chrome or Edge, which shortcut opens your recent Downloads list directly inside the browser?
What is the box with blinking lights at home or school that shares Wi-Fi internet with phones and computers?
In a school computer lab, many desktop PCs are plugged into internet wall sockets using a sturdy cable with a clip plug. What is that cable called?
On a mobile phone status bar, what do "4G" and "5G" indicate?
questions.option_a: Generations of mobile cellular network connectivity for internet and calls
questions.option_d: How many gigabytes of storage are left

questions.question_text: When you save a PDF circular FROM a school website ONTO your phone, is that called Downloading or Uploading?
When you select a photo FROM your computer and post/submit it TO an online portal, is that called Downloading or Uploading?
Look at the curved fan-shaped icon with 3 or 4 arcs in the corner of your phone or laptop screen. What does it show?
Which of these tasks works completely OFFLINE even when you have zero internet connection?
questions.option_d: Using the built-in Calculator or typing in Notepad

questions.question_text: Why do home and school Wi-Fi networks have a password?
questions.option_a: Because routers cannot turn on without a 20-letter name
questions.option_b: To make the router light turn blue
questions.option_d: So strangers outside cannot use your internet or access devices on your network

questions.question_text: When a YouTube video pauses with a spinning circle in the middle because the internet is slow, what is that called?
Roughly how far does normal Bluetooth (like wireless earbuds connected to your phone) usually reach clearly?
questions.option_c: A short room-size distance (around 10 meters / 30 feet)

questions.question_text: Your laptop says "Connected to Wi-Fi, No Internet." What does this message actually mean?
questions.option_a: Your laptop is connected to the Wi-Fi router in the room, but the router’s outside internet line is down
questions.option_d: Your laptop Wi-Fi card is broken

questions.question_text: Why are desktop computers in an exam lab often connected by Ethernet (LAN) cables instead of Wi-Fi?
questions.option_a: A wired Ethernet cable gives steadier, interference-free internet for 30+ PCs at the same time
questions.option_b: Desktop PCs can never use Wi-Fi
questions.option_c: LAN cables also power the monitor without electricity

questions.question_text: Internet plan speeds from providers like JioFiber, Airtel, or BSNL are commonly advertised in "100 Mbps". What does Mbps measure?
questions.option_a: How many months the plan lasts
questions.option_b: Megabits per second — how fast data transfers over your internet connection
questions.option_c: How far the Wi-Fi reaches in meters

questions.question_text: Companies like BSNL, Airtel, Jio, or local fiber broadband providers that connect homes/schools to the internet are called:
Why does Wi-Fi signal become weaker when you walk three rooms away behind thick concrete walls?
questions.option_d: Thick walls and distance absorb and weaken wireless radio waves from the router

questions.question_text: What is a "Local Area Network (LAN)" in simple everyday words?
questions.option_d: Computers, laptops, and printers connected together inside one building, home, or school campus

questions.question_text: If ONE Wi-Fi printer is connected to the school office Wi-Fi router, how many computers on that same Wi-Fi can print to it?
questions.option_a: Only a computer plugged into it with an HDMI cable
questions.option_b: All authorized computers/phones on that same Wi-Fi network can share and print to it wirelessly
questions.option_d: Only phones with no SIM card

questions.question_text: When you mirror your phone or laptop screen wirelessly onto a classroom Smart TV without any cable, what is that feature called?
In online group chats or comments, typing an entire message IN ALL CAPITAL LETTERS LIKE THIS is usually read as:
If a junior student asks a very basic computer question in the tech club, how should a good member respond?
questions.option_a: Explain it patiently and kindly — everyone starts as a beginner!
questions.option_d: Laugh at them in front of the group

questions.question_text: If someone repeatedly sends mean, hurtful, or threatening messages to a classmate online, what is that harmful behavior called?
questions.option_a: Cyberbullying (which must be reported to parents/teachers, never joined!)

questions.question_text: You receive a dramatic WhatsApp forward saying "Tomorrow is a sudden holiday — forward to 20 friends!" What is the smart, responsible step?
questions.option_b: Do NOT forward blindly — verify first from the official school notice or teacher

questions.question_text: Why shouldn’t you eat sticky snacks or keep an open cup of water right over a computer keyboard?
questions.option_c: Crumbs and spilled liquid can permanently short-circuit and ruin the keyboard or laptop

questions.question_text: If a pop-up flashes on screen: "🎉 CONGRATULATIONS! You won a free iPhone! Click here & enter your details!", what is it almost certainly?
questions.option_c: A real gift from your browser
questions.option_d: A scam / phishing trap trying to steal personal details or install malware — close it immediately!

questions.question_text: What is "Netiquette"?
questions.option_d: Good manners, kindness, and respectful behavior when communicating on the internet

questions.question_text: Should you share your home address, school timetable, and phone number publicly with unknown strangers in online game chats?
questions.option_a: Yes, if they have a cool profile picture
questions.option_b: No — keep personal details private to stay safe online
questions.option_c: Yes, if they offer free game coins
questions.option_d: Yes, on every public comment section

questions.question_text: When you use a diagram, photo, or quote created by someone else in your school presentation, what is the honest thing to do?
questions.option_b: Crop out their name and claim it as yours
questions.option_c: Give clear credit to the original creator or source instead of pretending you made it yourself
questions.option_d: Forbid anyone else from seeing the source

questions.question_text: To keep your eyes comfortable while studying or working on a computer, what does the healthy "20-20-20 Rule" recommend?
questions.option_a: Every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax your eyes
questions.option_d: Sit 20 millimeters from the screen for 20 hours

questions.question_text: Important UPI Safety Rule in India: Do you EVER need to enter your secret UPI PIN to RECEIVE money from someone?
questions.option_a: NEVER! A UPI PIN is ONLY entered when money is GOING OUT from your account — asking you to enter PIN to "receive" money is a scam!
questions.option_b: Yes, you must enter UPI PIN to receive gifts
questions.option_c: Yes, scanning any QR code automatically credits money after PIN
questions.option_d: UPI PIN is just your roll number

questions.question_text: What is "Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)" on email or social accounts, and why is it great?
questions.option_a: It forces two friends to share one account
questions.option_b: It adds a second check (like a code on your phone) besides your password, so thieves can’t break in with a leaked password alone
questions.option_c: It deletes your account after two days
questions.option_d: It slows down typing speed by half

questions.question_text: Why is reusing the EXACT SAME password across 10 different games, websites, and your main email risky?
questions.option_a: It uses extra storage on your phone
questions.option_c: If even one small game site gets hacked, attackers immediately try that same password on your email and other accounts!

questions.question_text: How should a responsible student use AI tools (like ChatGPT or Gemini) when working on a project or assignment?
questions.option_b: Trust every single date or quote from AI without checking
questions.option_c: Copy-paste the entire AI output without reading a word and sign it as 100% your own
questions.option_d: Use AI to brainstorm, understand tough ideas, or debug — then write/build in your own understanding and honestly mention where AI helped

questions.question_text: You install a simple "Flashlight" app on a phone, and it suddenly asks permission to read your Contacts, Call Logs, and Messages. What should you think?
questions.option_b: Flashlights need your contacts to shine brighter
questions.option_d: Deny/uninstall! A flashlight only needs the camera LED — asking for private contacts and messages is a big privacy red flag

questions.question_text: What is "Phishing"?
questions.option_b: Fake emails, SMS, or look-alike websites pretending to be a trusted bank/company to trick you into typing passwords or OTPs

questions.question_text: What does your "Digital Footprint" mean?
questions.option_a: The size of your laptop in inches
questions.option_b: Walking barefoot in the computer lab
questions.option_c: The lasting trail of posts, comments, photos, and public activity associated with you on the internet

questions.question_text: Why is downloading "Cracked / Pirated" paid software or game cheats from shady websites dangerous as well as unethical?
questions.option_a: Besides disrespecting creators’ work, pirated cracks are one of the #1 ways password-stealing malware infects home PCs!
questions.option_c: Official free alternatives like VLC, GIMP, or LibreOffice do not exist
questions.option_d: Cracked software runs faster and safer than official apps
